profile.headline: Agents at Pulumi
profile.summary:
Software Engineer focused on cloud infrastructure, backend systems, and developer tooling.

I currently work at Pulumi, building product and platform capabilities that help teams manage and understand cloud infrastructure at scale. My experience spans backend engineering, cloud/DevOps workflows, and full-stack development, with prior roles at Apple, Fidelity Investments, and Cornerstone Software.

I enjoy solving practical engineering problems with real customer impact, especially with systems design, developer experience, security/compliance, and infrastructure.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Powered millions of VCS deployments by architecting Pulumi Cloud's multi-VCS integration platform, automated deployment pipelines and AI-powered change summaries across GitHub, GitHub Enterprise Server, Bitbucket Cloud, Azure DevOps, and GitLab

Reached thousands of GitHub App installations spanning hundreds of thousands of repositories by extending the GitHub App to support multi-organization deployments

Drove adoption of AI-assisted policy remediation across thousands of enterprise organizations in its first months by building Pulumi Neo's PR workflow that generates pull requests to fix compliance violations

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Grew enterprise compliance scanning by 350%+ by architecting a Policy Management refresh and shipping a new out-of-the-box Policy Pack catalog

Surfaced millions of compliance violations across hundreds of thousands of cloud resources for organizations by building multi-cloud compliance enforcement across 5 frameworks (CIS, NIST, PCI DSS, HITRUST, Pulumi Best Practices) on AWS, Azure, and GCP, cutting policy setup from months to minutes

Contributed millions of GCP resource evaluations toward Pulumi Insights' multi-cloud scanning of cloud resources by engineering GCP scanners 

Enabled role-based compliance enforcement for thousands of enterprise organizations managing millions of cloud resources by building fine-grained access controls for policy management (Go, Angular, MySQL)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed a vendor product enabling companies to create distributed applications that connect to the HPE NonStop machine

Upgraded C and C++ code for modern Windows SDK increasing range of compatibility for user machines

Developed and packaged software for Hewlett Packard Enterprise utilized by 150 companies

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Automated infrastructure using Pulumi & TypeScript saving engineers 24-48 hours per request and delivering to customers up to 10 business days sooner

Improved team functionality and project efficiency through direct contributions

Collaborated with distributed teams in Texas and China using mTLS, Asynchronous Computing, Grafana, and Jira

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Collaborated with engineers and QA personnel to develop an internal facing test data service, improving feedback and exposure

Enhanced user experience by implementing accessibility features, leading to a 300% increase in interactions by Data Scientists

Engineered full stack solutions using Angular and Java Spring REST API

Created custom MySQL queries, significantly improving application modularity and efficiency

Deployed application on Azure Kubernetes AKS cluster and AWS using Jenkins CI/CD pipeline
